# Decision record: rate limiting at the edge

## Context

The public API currently enforces rate limits inside each service. Limits are inconsistent across services, and a burst from one client can exhaust a worker pool before the limit is checked. Support has handled six such incidents this quarter.

## Decision

We will enforce rate limits in the Envoy proxy at the edge, keyed by API token, with a default of 600 requests per minute. Services keep their existing checks for one release as a safety net and remove them afterwards.

## Consequences

Limits become visible in one place and can be changed without a deploy. Latency increases by about 2 milliseconds per request for the Redis lookup, which is acceptable. Clients that currently exceed 600 requests per minute will begin receiving HTTP 429 responses; we have identified four and will contact them before rollout.
